requirement: Each requirement and example definition badge MUST link to its own anchored definition on the current page. The badge MUST have a separate adjacent link containing an accessible right-arrow icon in an integrated segment matching the badge color linking to its evidence detail page. The badge and arrow MUST remain aligned in one non-wrapping row. Definitions MUST NOT be followed by a separate plaintext evidence link. Each detail page MUST link back to the definition's anchored badge and to the index. Reference badges MUST continue to link to the definition. These links MUST resolve when a requirement name contains `.md`, as in `requirements.cli.mdbook`.
rationale:
I judged this from the supplied tests alone and did not request implementation source. The tests cover every clause of `requirements.index.navigation`.

- **Badge links to its own anchor on the current page.**
  - `src/lib.rs#mod[tests]/fn[definitions_without_a_marker_get_a_default_index_and_detail_pages]` asserts `id="habeas-{kind}-rules.{name}" href="#habeas-{kind}-rules.{name}"` for a requirement, an example, and a `.md`-containing name.
  - `src/index.rs#mod[tests]/fn[index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters]` asserts the same anchor form for `requirements.core.ready`.
- **Separate adjacent arrow link to the evidence detail page.**
  - `src/lib.rs#mod[tests]/fn[index_owns_details_in_book_order_with_badge_icons]` asserts the icon's `title="View evidence"` and `aria-label="View evidence for ..."`, and a white arrow stroke.
  - It also asserts the detail href, including a nested index path and the `%2E` escaping.
  - `src/lib.rs#mod[tests]/fn[definition_evidence_link_targets_are_escaped]` asserts that the icon link's href is escaped and that its aria-label names the requirement.
  - `src/lib.rs#mod[tests]/fn[mdbook_preprocessor_renders_definitions_between_stdin_and_stdout]` checks the same link end to end through the CLI.
- **Integrated segment matching the badge color.** `src/lib.rs#mod[tests]/fn[definition_badge_and_evidence_icon_share_colors]` extracts the badge color and the icon's `background-color` from the same wrapper for both `req` and `example`, and asserts they are equal.
- **One non-wrapping aligned row.** `src/lib.rs#mod[tests]/fn[definition_badge_stylesheet_keeps_the_arrow_in_one_row]` asserts the stylesheet declarations that keep the wrapper and icon in one row. These are `inline-flex`, `align-items: center`, `flex-wrap: nowrap`, `white-space: nowrap`, `flex-shrink: 0`, and the icon's centering and height.
- **No separate plaintext evidence link.** Several tests assert that `See evidence` is absent from the definition content.
- **Detail pages link back to the definition anchor and to the index.**
  - The default index test asserts `[Requirements index](../requirements-index.html)` and `[View definition](../rules.html#habeas-req-rules.cli%2Emdbook)` and `[View definition](../rules/child.html#habeas-req-rules.child.nested)`.
  - The explicit-index tests assert the same links for an index in a subdirectory, in `index_owns_details_in_book_order_with_badge_icons` and `index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters`.
- **Reference badges still link to the definition.** `src/lib.rs#mod[tests]/fn[references_in_nested_chapters_link_to_the_requirement_definition]` asserts the `impl`, `cite` and `test` badges link to `../requirements.html#habeas-req-requirements.ready` from a nested chapter.
- **Names containing `.md`.** `src/lib.rs#mod[tests]/fn[links_preserve_requirement_names_containing_md]` asserts `chapter_href` output in both directions. The `cli.mdbook` cases above assert the same escaping inside the rendered output.

I found no unacknowledged gap.
